import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Modular {
        private static final int MOD = 1000000007;
        private long val;

        public Modular() {
            val = 0;
        }

        public Modular(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            val = v;
        }

        public Modular(long v, int mod) {
            MOD = mod;
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            val = v;
        }

        public static Modular valueOf(long v) {
            return new Modular(v);
        }

        public Modular add(Modular b) {
            val = (val + b.val) % MOD;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular sub(Modular b) {
            val = (val - b.val + MOD) % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular mul(Modular b) {
            val = (val * b.val) % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular div(Modular b) {
            return mul(b.inv());
        }

        public Modular inv() {
            long a = val, b = MOD, ax = 1, bx = 0;
            while (b != 0) {
                long q = a / b;
                long t = a % b;
                a = b;
                b = t;
                t = ax - bx * q;
                ax = bx;
                bx = t;
            }
            if (ax < 0) ax += MOD;
            return new Modular(ax);
        }

        public Modular pow(long p) {
            Modular a = new Modular(val);
            Modular ans = new Modular(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) ans = ans.mul(a);
                a = a.mul(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return ans;
        }

        public long getValue() {
            return val;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            Modular modular = (Modular) o;
            return val == modular.val;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return (int) (val ^ (val >>> 32));
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(val);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));
        
        int number = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        Modular[] probability = new Modular[number * number];
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < number * number; i++) {
            int percentage = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            probability[i] = Modular.valueOf(percentage).div(Modular.valueOf(100));
        }

        Modular[] total = new Modular[1 << (1 << 6)];
        int middle = number / 2;

        int[] maskValue = new int[1 << 6];
        int count = 0;
        for (int matchMask = 0; matchMask < (1 << 6); matchMask++) {
            maskValue[matchMask] = (Integer.bitCount(matchMask) == middle) ? count++ : -1;
        }
        total = new Modular[1 << count];
        for (int i = 0; i < total.length; i++) {
            total[i] = new Modular();
        }

        // Process first half
        for (int edgeMask = 0; edgeMask < (1 << (middle * number)); edgeMask++) {
            Modular totalProbability = new Modular(1);
            for (int tmp = edgeMask, i = 0; i < middle * number; i++, tmp >>= 1) {
                if ((tmp & 1) == 1) {
                    totalProbability = totalProbability.mul(probability[i]);
                } else {
                    totalProbability = totalProbability.mul(new Modular(1).sub(probability[i]));
                }
                if (totalProbability.getValue() == 0) {
                    continue;
                }
            }

            int[] data = new int[middle];
            int matchSets = 0;
            while (true) {
                int matchMask = 0;
                boolean valid = true;
                for (int index = 0; index < middle; index++) {
                    if ((edgeMask >> (index * number + data[index]) & 1) == 0) {
                        valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    if ((matchMask & (1 << data[index])) != 0) {
                        valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    matchMask |= 1 << data[index];
                }

                if (valid) {
                    if (middle == number) {
                        matchMask ^= (1 << number) - 1;
                    }
                    int idx = maskValue[matchMask];
                    if (idx != -1) {
                        matchSets |= 1 << idx;
                    }
                }

                // Increment data array
                boolean incremented = false;
                for (int i = middle - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    if (data[i] == number - 1) {
                        data[i] = 0;
                    } else {
                        data[i]++;
                        incremented = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!incremented) {
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (matchSets < total.length) {
                total[matchSets] = total[matchSets].add(totalProbability);
            }
        }

        // Sum over subsets
        for (int dim = 1; dim < total.length; dim <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < total.length; i++) {
                if ((i & dim) == 0) {
                    total[i | dim] = total[i | dim].add(total[i]);
                }
            }
        }

        Modular result = new Modular();
        
        // Process second half
        int secondHalfLen = number - middle;
        for (int edgeMask = 0; edgeMask < (1 << (secondHalfLen * number)); edgeMask++) {
            Modular totalProbability = new Modular(1);
            for (int tmp = edgeMask, i = middle * number; i < number * number; i++, tmp >>= 1) {
                if ((tmp & 1) == 1) {
                    totalProbability = totalProbability.mul(probability[i]);
                } else {
                    totalProbability = totalProbability.mul(new Modular(1).sub(probability[i]));
                }
                if (totalProbability.getValue() == 0) {
                    continue;
                }
            }

            int[] data = new int[secondHalfLen];
            int matchSets = 0;
            while (true) {
                int matchMask = 0;
                boolean valid = true;
                for (int index = 0; index < secondHalfLen; index++) {
                    if ((edgeMask >> (index * number + data[index]) & 1) == 0) {
                        valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    if ((matchMask & (1 << data[index])) != 0) {
                        valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    matchMask |= 1 << data[index];
                }

                if (valid) {
                    matchMask ^= (1 << number) - 1;
                    int idx = maskValue[matchMask];
                    if (idx != -1) {
                        matchSets |= 1 << idx;
                    }
                }

                // Increment data array
                boolean incremented = false;
                for (int i = secondHalfLen - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    if (data[i] == number - 1) {
                        data[i] = 0;
                    } else {
                        data[i]++;
                        incremented = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!incremented) {
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (matchSets < total.length) {
                int complement = total.length - 1 - matchSets;
                if (complement >= 0 && complement < total.length) {
                    result = result.add(totalProbability.mul(total[complement]));
                }
            }
        }

        pw.println((int) result.getValue());
        pw.close();
    }
}
